reasons.plausibility: The proposed temperature- and strain-rate–dependent dislocation-based mechanism aligns well with known FCC alloy deformation behavior and established material science principles for high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: Clear experimental protocols with well-defined temperature and strain-rate ranges, coupled with microstructural characterization, make the hypothesis straightforward to test and potentially falsify.
reasons.usefulness: Confirming or refuting this mechanism would directly guide alloy design and processing strategies to optimize dynamic properties in Co-free FeNiCrMn systems.
